# stalwart_mta_extensions (Data Source)

Configures SMTP protocol extensions offered to clients. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `chunking` (Attributes) Enables chunking (RFC 1830), an extension that allows large messages to be transferred in chunks which may reduce the load on the network and server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--chunking))
- `deliver_by` (Attributes) Specifies the maximum delivery time for a message using the DELIVERBY (RFC 2852) extension, which allows the sender to request a specific delivery time for a message (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deliver_by))
- `dsn` (Attributes) Enables delivery status notifications (RFC 3461), which allows the sender to request a delivery status notification (DSN) from the recipient's mail server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dsn))
- `expn` (Attributes) Specifies whether to enable the EXPN command, which allows the sender to request the membership of a mailing list. It is recommended to disable this command to prevent spammers from harvesting email addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--expn))
- `future_release` (Attributes) Specifies the maximum time that a message can be held for delivery using the FUTURERELEASE (RFC 4865) extension (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--future_release))
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `mt_priority` (Attributes) Specifies the priority assignment policy to advertise on the MT-PRIORITY (RFC 6710) extension, which allows the sender to specify a priority for a message. Available policies are mixer, stanag4406 and nsep, or false to disable this extension (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mt_priority))
- `no_soliciting` (Attributes) Specifies the text to include in the NOSOLICITING (RFC 3865) message, which indicates that the server does not accept unsolicited commercial email (UCE or spam) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--no_soliciting))
- `pipelining` (Attributes) Enables SMTP pipelining (RFC 2920), which enables multiple commands to be sent in a single request to speed up communication between the client and server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pipelining))
- `require_tls` (Attributes) Enables require TLS (RFC 8689), an extension that allows clients to require TLS encryption for the SMTP session (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--require_tls))
- `vrfy` (Attributes) Specifies whether to enable the VRFY command, which allows the sender to verify the existence of a mailbox. It is recommended to disable this command to prevent spammers from harvesting email addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfy))
